verdict.rationale: The only rollback evidence is "Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds", which describes checkpoints of Sprites (agent sandbox computers). It does not describe rolling back a deployed Fly App to a previous release or version. Nothing in the pack documents release history or one-click version rollback for deployed services, so the checkpoint claim is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click
